purpose: Overrides for the staging services while they run against the Aurora rehearsal clone. Applied as ONE task-definition revision per service, removed the same way. Nothing here is applied by any workflow yet: see rehearsal.md 'Workflow changes needed'.

clone.endpoint: <filled at window prep from: bash scripts/aws/rehearsal-clone.sh status>

window_prep_secrets.name: vitana/aurora/rehearsal/postgrest-authenticator-uri
window_prep_secrets.create_when: after the clone exists, before the staging proxy is repointed
window_prep_secrets.value: the value of vitana/aurora/prod/postgrest-authenticator-uri with ONLY the host replaced by the clone's cluster (writer) endpoint. Same role, same password (the clone carries production's pg_authid), same database 'vitana', same sslmode.
window_prep_secrets.how: an operator with secretsmanager:CreateSecret creates it from the existing secret without printing either value (read into a variable, substitute the host, create-secret --secret-string from that variable); tag Purpose=vtid-05023-part10-rehearsal. Delete it when the clone is deleted.
window_prep_secrets.note: The task asked for '...-url'; the existing production secret is named '...-uri' (vitana/aurora/prod/postgrest-authenticator-uri), so the rehearsal one follows that spelling.

postgrest.note: PGRST_DB_HOST is informational (PostgREST reads PGRST_DB_URI) but today it names the production writer; set it so the task definition does not lie. PGRST_JWT_SECRET stays vitana/gateway/staging/supabase-jwt-secret (members sign in on production GoTrue, whose secret it must equal).

environment_set.PUBLIC_HOST: <staging data host, e.g. data-staging.vitanaland.com — does not exist yet>

proxy.note: Only needed for the app half of the rehearsal (browser /rest/v1 through a public host). The image default is data.vitanaland.com; the staging task must not answer for the production host name.

optional_part4.precondition: scripts/aws/aurora-cutover-auth-bridge.sql applied to the CLONE first (PostgREST fails every request while the function is missing).

secrets_unset.SUPABASE_URL: today vitana/supabase/staging/url (production Supabase). Replaced by the plain value below; ECS cannot carry a secret and an env var of the same name.
secrets_unset.AURORA_DATABASE_URL: today vitana/aurora/prod/database-url: a direct admin connection to PRODUCTION Aurora (db-i18n; DB_I18N_TARGET is unset = supabase). Removed so nothing in the rehearsal can reach the production cluster directly.
secrets_unset.GATEWAY_INTERNAL_TOKEN: today vitana/gateway/staging/internal-token. Removed so every EventBridge Scheduler call aimed at the staging gateway (AP-xxxx automation crons, test-contract scanners, dev-memory handoff sweep, community-autopilot scan) is rejected while staging reads the clone. Disabling those schedules is the primary control (rehearsal.md D); this is the belt.

unchanged_on_purpose.VITANA_ENV: staging (keeps the hard staging blocks: email fallback, outbox worker, auth-bridge reconciler, reward sweep, reward reservation sweep)
unchanged_on_purpose.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE / SUPABASE_ANON_KE: production Supabase keys; PostgREST on the clone accepts them because the proxy's PGRST_JWT_SECRET is the same secret

no_switch_mitigations.lifecycle-notification-worker: run scripts/aws/rehearsal-clone-neutralize.sql on the clone before the overlay (marks every waiting lifecycle row notified; revokes every FCM device token on the clone)
no_switch_mitigations.autonomous-engine: writes recommendations / OASIS rows on the clone only; no outbound sender found; AUTO_ACTIVATE_RECOMMENDATIONS stays unset. Accepted for the rehearsal, needs a switch before the next one
no_switch_mitigations.one-shot boot writes: agents_registry PATCH, VTID-01178 ensure row, conversation.system.snapshot OASIS event: clone-only, accepted

repository_variables.VITE_REALTIME_URL_STAGING: <unset unless a staging Realtime against the clone exists (it does not); then realtime stays on Supabase>

staging_app.note: A staging frontend build (AWS-STAGE-DEPLOY-FRONTEND.yml) bakes these in; unsetting them and rebuilding is the revert. The community-app container itself is static nginx and runs nothing server-side.

eventbridge_schedules_to_disable.why: These Scheduler entries call the STAGING gateway (gateway_url = https://preview-aws-gateway.vitanaland.com, per scripts/aws/setup-eventbridge-cron-migration.sh defaults). Exact live list could not be read from this session (scheduler:ListSchedules denied); confirm with `aws scheduler list-schedules` and each Input's gateway_url at window prep.
